view.en: Side-view 2D single-screen arena. You control a small round pink creature that walks, jumps, puffs up to float, inhales and spits stars; your health bars and the boss's name and health bar are shown at the top of the screen

goal.en: Empty the boss's health bar to win; you lose when your health bars run out; each fight has a time limit and a timeout is not a win. Health does not regenerate. After a hit you blink and are invulnerable for about 1.5 seconds

mouse.en: The mouse is not used; LMB does the same as J

keys.en: walk left (fly left in the airship fight)
walk right (fly right in the airship fight)
puff up and float and rise in the air; stops an inhale that pulls nothing; rises in the airship fight
duck on the ground with an empty mouth; swallows a full mouthful; sinks in the airship fight
jump, higher the longer you hold; press again in the air to puff and float
hold to inhale what is in front; with a full mouth press to spit a star; while floating press to blow a puff (harmless to bosses); in the airship fight press to blow an air bullet to the right

notes.en: In the ground scenes only a spat star hurts the boss: first inhale something the boss throws (an apple, a walker, a bomb, a box), then spit it back at the boss. You cannot walk while inhaling; reach is about 5 units, about 2.5 units of vertical tolerance

The airship fight controls differ: you fly the whole fight, with no jumping or inhaling. A/D move horizontally and stop at once, W rises fast, S sinks slower, and with neither you hang in the air; you always face right, and each J/LMB press blows one air bullet to the right (about one every 0.25 s, at most two in the air). Stay on the left of the airship to hit it
J and jump trigger on the press: inhale, spit, jump and puff all start the moment the key goes down; holding J keeps inhaling and holding Space makes the jump higher
Pressing J while floating blows a puff and ends the float; holding W keeps flapping upward. A hit knocks you sideways but keeps your mouthful and your float

Some things cannot be inhaled (spiky balls, air puffs) and still hurt you; dodge them. Most hits cost 1 health bar, spiky balls cost 3. Some moves appear only in the extended mode and are tagged expert mode only

mouth.en: mouth action (J): inhale, spit, swallow timing

options.hold: hold J for the whole packet (inhale, or spit when full)

options.jump: hold Space (high jump; rises when puffing in the air)
options.jump_late: press and hold Space from sub-step 2
options.float: hold W (puff and rise; rise while flying)
options.down_tap: tap S (swallow / drop through a thin platform)
options.jump_half: hold Space for the first half (medium jump)

summary.en: A shooter-style fight high in the sky: you fly throughout and can only blow air bullets to the right, so stay on the airship's left. A hit gives about 1.5 seconds of blinking with no knockback

tell.en: The cannon opens under the hull (or over it after the blimp rolls over), then fires one bullet, three in a row, or a fan of three

effect.en: A bullet hit costs 1 health bar; the straight shots fly about 16 px above or below its centre

counter.en: Level with its middle, only the fan's slanted bullets come at you; your air bullets pass through its bullets, so keep firing while dodging

tell.en: The blimp backs away and tips toward your side (up, level or down), then dashes across the screen and floats back

effect.en: Contact costs 1 health bar, and you cannot outrun it sideways

counter.en: Move out of its line up or down (rising is twice as fast as sinking) and keep firing as it floats back

summary.en: A close-quarters fight on a ring stage: he has four moves, each aimed at where you were. You must inhale things he throws or drops and spit them back

tell.en: Steps back a little, waddles toward you, and within about 3 units throws himself into a belly slide

effect.en: The slide costs 1 health bar on contact; he has super armour during the slide and while lying there

counter.en: Jump or float over him as the slide starts; a star still hurts him while he lies there

tell.en: Crouches, then leaps high toward you (straight up if you are overhead) and crashes down

effect.en: The landing costs 1 health bar, and two stars pop out beside him, lasting only about 0.6 seconds

counter.en: Be inhaling next to the landing spot, then inhale a star and spit it back

tell.en: Backs off, walks to where you were, opens his mouth and sucks for up to about 1.7 seconds

effect.en: If caught you are spat into the ropes for 1 health bar

counter.en: Stay out of the roughly 5.75-unit cone in front of his mouth; above or behind him is safe

tell.en: Hops in place, walks to where you were, raises the hammer behind him and swings it over his head into the floor in front

effect.en: The swing covers his back, his head and about 4 units of floor in front for 1 health bar; one star drops in front of him on the ground hit

counter.en: Stand off, then inhale the dropped star and spit it back

summary.en: An aerial fight above the clouds: the cloud floats high and your ammunition is the one-eyed walkers it drops (bombs in the extended mode). It is easiest to hit at the bottom of a swoop

tell.en: Drifts about 12 units to the other side; if you are below on that side it rises, then swoops down near the floor and back up

effect.en: Touching the cloud costs 1 health bar; a swoop passes about 1.1 units above the floor

counter.en: Duck (S) under it or get out of the way; mid-swoop is the best moment to hit it

tell.en: The cloud crackles; sparks shoot out from two opposite points and turn half a circle around it

effect.en: Touching a spark costs 1 health bar; they reach about 8.75 units from the centre

counter.en: Keep a long horizontal distance and stay off the diagonals

tell.en: A one-eyed walker pops out of the cloud and walks toward your side; one in two stops, flashes and sweeps a beam from overhead to the floor in front

effect.en: Contact or the beam costs 1 health bar

counter.en: This is your ammunition: face it, hold J to inhale it, then jump and spit it straight up at the cloud

tell.en: The cloud loops out and back across the arena dropping three bombs that fall and burst above the floor

effect.en: A bomb burst that reaches you costs 1 health bar

counter.en: Inhale a falling bomb before it bursts; in this mode bombs are the only ammunition, and the far corner is out of reach

tell.en: Rears back away from you, then dives fast down to the floor on your side and loops back

effect.en: Contact costs 1 health bar; it is the only attack in this mode that reaches the corner

counter.en: Duck under it with S

summary.en: A fight in castle corridors: two brothers come out of gates at the ends of a corridor to push a box. The key is turning the box into your weapon

tell.en: A brother pops out of a gate at one end of the corridor with a box in front of him, stands a moment, then starts pushing

effect.en: The box is pushed down the corridor and costs 1 health bar if it hits you

counter.en: Get into that corridor ahead of the box, inhale it, and spit the star straight back down the corridor; the brother is right behind it

tell.en: After a push ends, the brother goes back through his gate and the gate at the other end opens for the next one

effect.en: It does no damage itself, it only changes the direction of the push

counter.en: Watch which gate opens and move to that corridor to inhale the box

summary.en: A one-on-one on flat ground: he stays near his spot, and the threat comes from his bombs and big leaps. Bombs are your ammunition

tell.en: Small hops on the spot, back and forth, in two pairs

effect.en: His body costs 1 health bar on contact

counter.en: He only hops in place; stay a few units away and wait for the bomb

tell.en: Jumps straight up with a bomb overhead; either lobs it from the top of the jump, or hangs there, lands and rolls it along the floor

effect.en: The bomb comes toward you and bursts in a 5 by 5 unit blast where its path ends, costing 1 health bar

counter.en: Inhale the bomb first, then spit it back at him

tell.en: A medium hop toward you and back, then a huge leap across the room; he always returns to his spot

effect.en: Contact near the landing costs 1 health bar; he drops no bomb during the leap

counter.en: Get clear of the landing, or duck (his box stops about 9 px above his feet)

tell.en: Backs up a step and dashes across the floor at full speed, then runs back

effect.en: Contact costs 1 health bar

counter.en: Jump or float over the dash, or duck under his box

summary.en: A stationary target on a grassy field: the tree stands at one end and attacks with air puffs and falling apples. Inhale its apples and spit them at the trunk

tell.en: The mouth opens into an O, then an air puff shoots out low along the floor, drifting up or down

effect.en: A puff costs 1 health bar on contact and cannot be inhaled

counter.en: Hop or float over it, or duck under one drifting up

tell.en: Four puffs in quick succession, the mouth snapping open each time

effect.en: Each puff costs 1 health bar on contact

counter.en: Float above the floor until the burst passes

tell.en: An apple blinks among the leaves, drops, then bounces along the floor toward you

effect.en: An apple hitting you costs 1 health bar

counter.en: Face it, hold J to inhale it, then spit it at the trunk; this is the only way to hurt the tree

tell.en: A spiky ball, then an apple, then either one, are dropped in turn

effect.en: A spiky ball costs 3 health bars on contact and cannot be inhaled

counter.en: Only the apples are ammunition; dodge the spiky balls
